rationale: Standard-effort create flow. The supplied material is four declared readings against a per-consignment limit plus a weight and a dock, so the thesis is a cold-store worksheet: a compact consignment roster (weight, dock, excursion pill) beside the selected consignment's evidence, with an original labelled ordinal reading-trace schematic that plots each reading against the dashed declared-limit line. Limit breaches are shown three ways (table row state, schematic point outside the line, and a written verdict naming the reading and the margin), release is a genuinely disabled control with an adjacent explanation, and the flow is decision -> review -> simulated failure -> retry -> success with a frozen record so edit and retry keep the same facts. Changing consignment clears decision and note. Palette is cold-store teal/ice with ochre for excursions, all system fonts, no external requests. Copy states that limits are declared fixtures and no real shipment, release or food-safety determination occurred.
